about: Marin'Or stamp tear geometry, canvas px @1x (1080x1350, origin top-left). Generated by tools/build_tear.py (seed 20261013). Spec: SPEC_timbre-marmite.md 6.4/6.5/9.

pictureClip.note: lips/liseré already clipped to vignette rect U printed flame polygons (the original flames overhang the vignette bottom by 7.4 px)

front.unit: s = arc length along the BASE (un-noised) polyline of each branch, px; trunk from S, branches from N
front.showRule: show a lip/liseré chunk when front_s[chunk.branch](f) > chunk.s0 (strict) (chunks overlap 1 px: opaque white, no AA seams). From f36 on, swap the chunks for fragments.*.lips.fullD / lisere.fullD (single clean paths).
front.hairline: optional f34-f35 only (before the fragments move): stroke crack.*.d up to the front, #4D4D4D, 1.2 px, opacity 0.55

spring.rule: rot, translate and tilt/luminance = multiplier x rest values (the spec's x1.35 column is the rounded x1.35 of the rest column; use the table values at f38)

tiltLighting.convention: After Effects right-handed axes (x right, y down, z into screen): +rotY turns the face left, +rotX turns the face down. Key light upper-left (pot shading). Shift = filter brightness(1+L) on the fragment group.

slit.note: micro-split along the first 10 px of the trunk; reads on the white margin

fibres.note: white fibres frayed into the notch void; read on dark page backgrounds
